content.short: Amnis Finance is a leading liquid staking protocol on Aptos that maximizes APT yield through yield tokenization.
content.description: Amnis Finance is a premier liquid staking protocol on the Aptos blockchain, designed to maximize yield for APT holders while maintaining liquidity. Users receive amAPT or stAPT for their staked assets, allowing them to earn rewards while utilizing tokens across the DeFi ecosystem. The protocol features an innovative yield tokenization model, splitting assets into Principal and Yield Tokens for advanced trading and hedging. Amnis is integrated with major Aptos platforms like Aries Markets for additional yield, providing a secure gateway for both retail and institutional APT staking users.
content.meta: Amnis Finance offers liquid staking and yield tokenization on the Aptos network. Discover Amnis and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
